mainSet.name: Maximum REPEAT Interval Segment

Perform dynamic stretches

easier.description: Reduce interval volume by running 2 repetitions.

notes: Maintain consistent pacing throughout all 4 repeats.

harder.description: Increase interval volume by running 5 repetitions.

mainSet.description: Harder version: increased volume to 5 reps.
notes: Maintain consistent pacing throughout all 4 repeats.

Use the 180s recovery to lower heart rate curves.

coachingNotes: Full recovery between sprints ensures maximal speed quality and reduces injury risk.
Emphasize explosive starts, rapid arm drive, and proper ankle stiffness.
Ensure full nervous system recovery; do not rush starts while feeling winded.
commonMistakes: Rushing recovery times, which degrades explosive speed quality and increases muscular tension.

Do not push past any muscular tightness or cramping in hamstrings or calves.
Perform high-speed repeats on flat surfaces with clean traction.
